definition: A chamber work's level is the level, on this 1–10 scale, that its hardest part asks of its player, raised by up to one level when holding the ensemble together (coordination, exposed intonation, stamina, balance) is harder than the notes. For a part on another instrument, read the scale as the same exam grade on that instrument: level 4 is about ABRSM grade 7 piano, cello, flute or viol. Grade the whole work as usually performed, not its hardest bar.
